Title: RSU International Dorm
ReviewOrGuideText: Clean room and safe building, but Wi-Fi is sometimes slow at night.

Title: Main Cafeteria Noodle Stall
ReviewOrGuideText: Affordable noodles with big portions. Lunch queue is long after 12 PM.

Title: How to Get a Student ID Replacement
ReviewOrGuideText: Bring passport copy, student number, and 100 baht fee. Staff were helpful.

Title: Campus Residence B
ReviewOrGuideText: Good location near classes, but laundry machines are limited on weekends.

Title: Halal Food Corner
ReviewOrGuideText: Useful option for Muslim students. Menu is clear and staff can explain ingredients.

Title: Where to Print Documents on Campus
ReviewOrGuideText: Library printing is easy, but bring small cash because online payment was unavailable.

Title: Private Apartment Near Gate 2
ReviewOrGuideText: Quiet and spacious, but rent is higher than campus dorms.

Title: Vegetarian Rice Stall
ReviewOrGuideText: Good vegetarian choices, but labels should include English translations.

Title: First Week Campus Checklist
ReviewOrGuideText: Helpful checklist for SIM card, uniform, transport card, and classroom search.

Title: Shared Room in Campus Residence A
ReviewOrGuideText: Roommate matching was okay. Storage space is small but location is convenient.

Title: Coffee Kiosk Near Library
ReviewOrGuideText: Good coffee for morning classes, but not many snack choices.

Title: Using Campus Shuttle for the First Time
ReviewOrGuideText: Shuttle is helpful but schedule should be posted in English near the stop.

Title: Budget Dorm Near Campus
ReviewOrGuideText: Cheap rent and friendly owner, but walking back at night feels less safe.

Title: Thai Curry Stall
ReviewOrGuideText: Food tastes good, but spice level is hard to understand without Thai language.

Title: Best Places to Study Between Classes
ReviewOrGuideText: Library is quiet, while the lounge is better for group work and laptop charging.

Title: International Student Residence
ReviewOrGuideText: Friendly environment for new students. Reception helped with basic Thai instructions.

Title: Budget Breakfast Set
ReviewOrGuideText: Good value before 10 AM. Sells out quickly during exam week.

Title: How to Find Classrooms Quickly
ReviewOrGuideText: Building signs are confusing at first. Taking screenshots of the map helped.

Title: Studio Apartment Near 7-Eleven
ReviewOrGuideText: Convenient location and private bathroom, but electricity bill is expensive.

Title: Japanese Bento Stall
ReviewOrGuideText: Tasty and clean presentation, but price is higher than Thai food stalls.

Title: Where to Ask for Visa Support
ReviewOrGuideText: International Office explained the documents clearly, but appointments fill up fast.

Title: Older Campus Dorm Block C
ReviewOrGuideText: Affordable and near cafeteria, but bathroom maintenance needs improvement.

Title: Fruit Smoothie Shop
ReviewOrGuideText: Fresh smoothies and easy ordering by pointing at pictures.

Title: Emergency Contacts for New Students
ReviewOrGuideText: Important phone numbers should be saved before arriving on campus.

Title: Off-campus Shared House
ReviewOrGuideText: Good for groups of friends. Transport is needed for morning classes.

Title: Korean Chicken Stall
ReviewOrGuideText: Popular stall with crispy chicken. Waiting time is long during dinner.

Title: How to Join Student Clubs
ReviewOrGuideText: Club fair was useful, but social media pages had more updated information.

Title: New Private Dorm with Gym
ReviewOrGuideText: Modern facilities and gym access, but deposit is expensive.

Title: International Food Day Booth
ReviewOrGuideText: Fun food event with different cultures. It should be announced earlier.

Title: Campus Apps and Online Portals
ReviewOrGuideText: A single guide for login steps would save time for new students.
